*Last updated: 24 November 2026*

Stochastika (stochastika.com) respects your privacy. This page explains what data is processed when you visit the site.

## Cookies and tracking

The site currently **uses no cookies, no analytics and no advertising**. All interactive elements run entirely in your browser; nothing you type into them is sent anywhere.

## Hosting and external libraries

- The site is hosted by **Netlify**, which logs technical data (such as IP addresses) for security and service operation.
- Some libraries (for mathematical formulas and interactive charts) are loaded from the **jsDelivr** and **cdnjs** (Cloudflare) content delivery networks, which also receive your IP address when they load.

## Future changes

If advertising or analytics are added, this page will be updated and your consent will be requested before any non-essential cookies are used.

## Contact

For any question about your personal data: [info@stochastika.com](mailto:info@stochastika.com)
